name: Local causal pathway discovery benchmark for scRNA-seq
description: Benchmark study assessing methods for local causal pathway discovery on single-cell RNA-seq count data, measuring causal inference accuracy and robustness.
reputation: Recognized within the single-cell causal inference community as a targeted benchmark for evaluating local causal pathway discovery methods, but with limited broad adoption outside that specialty.
notes: Benchmark operates on single-cell RNA-seq count data and therefore is sensitive to sparsity, batch effects, and unobserved confounding; evaluation focuses on local causal edge recovery rather than global network reconstruction. Non-LLM benchmark; sample size and realistic perturbation data may be limited.
